data.action: 坐在天台长椅上咬着筷子凝望天空
data.description: 【后藤一里 · 天台午休时光】空旷安静的教学楼天台铁丝网旁，微风拂过蔚蓝天际。后藤一里坐在长椅上打开便当盒，微风掀动水手服的领巾，她咬着筷子望向远方的积雨云，享受着无拘无束的片刻独处——「不用看别人脸色的天台……是世界上最棒的秘密宝座。」
data.lighting: 明媚正午天光与开阔天际反光
data.promptProse: High above the school on a tranquil rooftop beside a tall chain-link fence, Gotoh Hitori sits comfortably on a wooden bench holding an open bento lunchbox. Gentle summer thermals ruffle her navy sailor collar and pink hair as towering white cumulonimbus clouds drift across an endless cobalt sky. She holds a chopstick lightly between her lips while daydreaming with a relaxed, serene expression. Bright natural daylight and deep aerial perspective create a peaceful, expansive slice-of-life anime frame.
data.title: 后藤一里 · 天台午休时光
